# SandboxShape

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/sandbox/sandbox.h`](../../../src/logic/sandbox/sandbox.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

A drawn collision shape of a sandbox animal (Sandbox::draw), next to its Transform, WorldShape and ModelRef.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `animal` | `entt::entity` | the animal whose segment it follows |

## Notes

Created by makeShapes (draw worlds only) when an animal spawns or grows, placed every tick by SandboxLife (moveShapes, which adds a PhysicsPose), destroyed with its animal.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Sandbox, SandboxLife, SandboxObserve. Written by: Sandbox, SandboxObserve. Created by: Sandbox, SandboxObserve. Destroyed by: Sandbox, SandboxObserve.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md) | system | World | **write+create** | init (populate), tick (makeShapes, draw) | one entity per collision shape of the ragdoll, linked to its animal, when the world draws (`draw`) |
| [Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md) | system | World | **read+destroy** | init (populate), tick, finish (removeShapes) | the drawn shapes whose `animal` is the one removed are destroyed (with their Transform, WorldShape, ModelRef, PhysicsPose) |
| [SandboxLife](../systems/SandboxLife.md) | system | World | **read** | tick (moveShapes, draw) | the animal each drawn shape follows |
| [SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md) | system | World | **write+create** | tick (reset: populate) (makeShapes, draw) | one entity per collision shape of the ragdoll, linked to its animal, when the world draws (`draw`) |
| [SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md) | system | World | **read+destroy** | tick (reset: populate) (removeShapes) | the drawn shapes whose `animal` is the one removed are destroyed (with their Transform, WorldShape, ModelRef, PhysicsPose) |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md)**
  - Reads resources/agents/params/life.params.json (or `life`), resources/agents/params/animal.params.json, the generated bodies resources/animals/bodies/<id>.body.json and resources/agents/rewards/<id>.rewards.json (hashes kept); throws std::runtime_error on a missing life file, an unknown species or a weapon segment the body lacks.
  - Builds a Jolt ragdoll per animal (bodies and constraints in the animal collision layer, group = its ragdoll group), destroys it when the animal leaves or grows; four static wall boxes round the arena.
  - Installs SandboxSys::Contacts as the PhysicsSystem's contact listener: it records the estimated impulse of every contact between two ragdolls (from Jolt's threads, under a mutex) for SandboxLife.
  - Creates and destroys entities: animals, minds, drawn shapes and grass tiles.
  - Logs one debug line per species at init (count, bodies, standing muzzle height, reward terms and round).
- **[SandboxLife](../systems/SandboxLife.md)**
  - Drains the contact listener's recorded events (the listener is SandboxSys's).
- **[SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md)**
  - On a RESET: every animal and its ragdoll destroyed and the population drawn again (entities and Jolt bodies created and destroyed).
